debit.notes: Customer care 24/7 (grievance page: 'Customer Care Contact number (24/7): 1860 210 3456'); overseas +91 44 6685 4555; debit-card page also lists +91 44 4902 1180. App/netbanking path: DBS digibank app or internet banking > Accounts > 'Debit Cards' tab > select card > 'Permanently Block/Unblock' (temporary block: 'Temporary Block/Unblock'; SMS 'TBLK <last 4 digit of debit card>' to 7065154444, unblock 'TUNBLK <last 4 digit of debit card>'). Branch visits also accepted. Bank's pages ask online-fraud victims to call National Cyber Crime helpline 1930 / report at cybercrime.gov.in.

credit.notes: 24/7 (grievance page: 'Call Us (24/7) - DBS Credit Card helpline: 1860 267 6789'; overseas +91 44 6904 6789). DBS Vantage Credit Card dedicated helpline: 1800 209 4555 (overseas Vantage: +91 44 6685 4555; Vantage email vantagecareindia@dbs.com). Report page: 'You can also login to your DBS mobile app to block your debit card/credit card immediately' (digibank app). Bank's pages ask online-fraud victims to call National Cyber Crime helpline 1930 / report at cybercrime.gov.in.

upi.notes: DBS India's pages publish no full account-level UPI off-switch, UPI SMS keyword, *99# path or netbanking UPI-manage path. The official UPI FAQ publishes an in-app UPI Settings toggle in the digibank app: 'UPI international will be deactivated automatically after validity period which is set by customer'; to deactivate before that — DBS accounts: 'Tap accounts section on the Digi bank app home screen. Select the account for which you may want to Disable. Tap Settings. Toggle UPI International under the UPI Settings. Confirm'; external accounts: 'Tap at UPI Linked accounts section on the Digi bank app home screen. Select the account for which you may want to Disable. Tap Settings. Toggle UPI Global under the UPI Settings. Enter UPI PIN. Confirm.' UPI Autopay: 'Simply disable “Autopay” from the settings, on the respective platform/app where it was enabled or delete the mandate from the UPI app in which it was created.' Foreign-inward-remittance UPI opt-out: email UPI_PayNow_FIR@dbs.com (general help customercareindia@dbs.com). FAQ 'Need Help?': 1860 210 3456 / 1860 267 4567 (India), +91 44 6685 4555 (overseas).
